subject: Post-incident summary, commitments, and verification instructions
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Brief update on yesterday's inference disruption / next steps

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the quick sync this morning. I wanted to follow up in writing with a concise set of commitments from Redwood and immediate next steps so BlueHarbor has a single reference point. We know the disruption yesterday impacted peak inference for a subset of requests on your dedicated pool between ~18:40-18:58 UTC and that had downstream effects on your customer-facing flows.

Immediate items we committed to on the call:
- Deliver a short RCA draft and timeline by EOD tomorrow (2026-09-09 PST).
- Provide a remediation checklist and verification steps you can run to validate post-fix behavior.
- Enable a temporary routing policy to fallback to a compatible model variant for your traffic while longer-term fixes are implemented.

I'm attaching a compact packet (draft RCA, event timeline CSV, and mitigation checklist) — please treat this as the first delivery; we'll refine after your review.

Attachments: 20260908_rca_summary.pdf (PDF), 20260908_timeline.csv (CSV), 20260908_mitigation_checklist.xlsx (XLSX)

If you'd like a short walkthrough of the RCA this week, Grace and I can run 30 minutes on Thursday.

Thanks,

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Reliability Lead, Redwood Inference
hannah@redwood.ai

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>, security@blueharbor.com
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Formal RCA + timeline (draft) — Redwood incident impacting BlueHarbor dedicated pool

Alex / BlueHarbor security team —

Attached is the formal draft RCA and an expanded timeline. Below is a concise executive summary and the set of action owners/ETAs. We labeled this as a DRAFT while we collect logs and continue a short validation run; expect a final PDF next week after verification.

Executive summary:
- Root cause: A serving runtime regression introduced in 2026-09-07 03:05 UTC (deployment tag: rdc-server-1.8.4) caused sub-second KV cache invalidations under a narrow sequence-length distribution. Those invalidations triggered a cascade where the request routing layer retried to alternate backends more aggressively than intended, which in combination with an autoscaler cooldown mismatch produced transient saturation of a subset of worker nodes.
- Impact window: 2026-09-07 18:40:02 UTC — 2026-09-07 18:57:50 UTC (approx).
- Scope: ~2.8% of requests from your dedicated pool experienced increased p99 latency and an elevated retry rate; error rates spiked for requests exceeding 2048 token sequences.

Key remediation actions (owner — ETA):
- Roll back rdc-server-1.8.4 for BlueHarbor dedicated cluster (Hannah Schmitt / now — rolled at 18:58 UTC)
- Patch KV cache invalidation logic and add unit/integration tests for edge sequence distributions (Runtime Team / 2026-09-14)
- Adjust routing retry backoff logic to limit cascade under partial saturation (Runtime Team / 2026-09-10)
- Autoscaler cooldown policy review and safety threshold adjustment (Platform Ops / 2026-09-12)
- Enable temporary routing policy to direct BlueHarbor >95th percentile traffic to a compatible model variant (Grace O'Connor / in place by 2026-09-09 10:00 UTC)

Verification checklist for BlueHarbor (short):
1) Confirm baseline traffic replay with sequence-length distribution match (we provided a sample replay script).
2) Validate p99 latency and retry rates fall within expected thresholds during replay (we recommend 2 runs of 10 minutes each).
3) Confirm no model output regressions on your key test prompts (we will run your shared prompt set against the compatible variant).

Attachments in this draft: 20260908_rca_summary.pdf (compact narrative), 20260908_timeline.csv (event series: timestamps, routing decisions, retry counts), 20260908_mitigation_checklist.xlsx (owner/ETA matrix).

Next steps we propose:
- Grace and I will host a 30-minute verification walkthrough Thursday 2026-09-10 10:00 PT (we'll include runtime engineers). Please confirm or propose another slot.
- We'll deliver the verified RCA + final attachments by next Wednesday (2026-09-15) after the runtime patch is validated.

If you want us to redact any internal-only telemetry before sharing broadly with your compliance group, say the word and we'll prepare a sanitized packet.

Thanks again for your patience — we're treating this with high priority.

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Reliability Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@blueharbor.com>, security@blueharbor.com
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2026 14:35:00 -0700
Subject: Verification walkthrough notes & how to confirm closure

Alex / BlueHarbor team —

Thanks for joining the verification call this morning. Short note to capture the outcome and next actions so you have a discrete checklist to close your risk item.

Outcome summary:
- We validated the rollback and patching strategy in a staging replay and observed stable p99 latency under matched traffic for two 10-minute runs.
- Temporary routing policy was exercised and produced no regressions on your representative prompt set.
- Autoscaler cooldown thresholds were updated and monitored for 24 hours with no re-occurrence.

BlueHarbor closure checklist (what we need from you):
- Confirm acceptance of the sanitized RCA for archiving in your compliance system (reply-all with "RCA accepted" and date).
- Sign off on the mitigation owner/ETA table (we will mark items as complete as the Runtime and Platform Ops teams finish work).
- Run one replay using your production traffic window and confirm metrics (attach replay summary csv).

We will:
- Deliver final RCA PDF and a sanitized telemetry packet for your records by EOD Monday 2026-09-13.
- Keep the temporary routing rule active until you confirm replay metrics are within thresholds or until 2026-09-20, whichever comes first.

If anything else is needed for your audit trail, ping me directly and we'll prioritize.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Principal Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
